loading.comment: not even close, zeker optie 1 is veel te schreeuwerig, het moet veel subtieler zijn
loading.reply: Too loud, yes: I filled the whole part with a picture, and a loading state should not be a picture. Update 4 goes the other way: eight quiet ones that leave the part exactly as it is and only change something small about it, in whole 90 ms frames in retro’s own greys, nothing coloured and nothing filling the part. The part stays readable underneath. My pick is the dither shimmer, the one thing on a 1995 screen that was always slightly moving.
